text:
sam: Quick check-in 00:00 UTC change window. rolling SDK 3.0 -> runtime 4.1 in EU canary tomorrow. we've got two small compatibility signals from nightly: (1) subtle tokenization mismatch for whitespace-heavy prompts (~0.15% drift), (2) rare decode truncation in longchat (>1024) under load. thinking we should JIT soft-pin the `whitespace-eu` cohort to runtime 4.0 for the window and monitor. opinions?

nicole: Want to confirm scope: soft-pin only the cohort routing layer (no infra changes), correct? Also what's the gating rule?

sre-lee: yes: routing-only. i'll need a start_ts and a defined metric gate. suggest gate: `tokenization_delta >= 0.2%` OR `decode_trunc_rate > 0.05%` over 15m. if triggered, keep pin and escalate.

deploybot: deploybot: request template: {group: `whitespace-eu`, target: `runtime-4.0`, kind: `soft`, start_ts, expire_s}. once provided i will schedule.

ops-jay: add an additional safety: if cpu_load > 85% on canary hosts during window, abort rollout entirely. we've seen high CPU correlate with truncations.

qa-sam: i'll run a preflight suite at T-45m against 2k synthetic prompts (mixed-length). will post diff vs runtime-4.1. ETA ~T-30m.

doc-raya: heads up to docs/support: add a short blurb to release notes about the SDK 3.0 behavioral changes with whitespace-edgecases and note the canary soft-pin strategy. i'll draft after preflight.

sam: proposed values: start_ts=1713463200 (02:00 UTC), expire_s=10800 (3h), gate as @sre-lee proposed, cpu guard as @ops-jay suggested. auto-unpin if metrics below gate for 45m continuous.

nicole: confirm pinlist.csv update needed with `soft=true, reason=tokenization-trunc-compat`, and a `notes_url` field to docs PR.

sre-lee: runbook snippet for emergency lift: ```bash
# check truncation rate
curl -s "https://telemetry.internal/m?m=decode_trunc_rate&g=whitespace-eu&w=15m" | jq .value
# manual unpin
curl -X POST "https://deploybot.internal/pins/unpin" -d '{"pin_id":"pin-1713456789"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

deploybot: deploybot: scheduling soft pin id `pin-1713456789` for `whitespace-eu` -> `runtime-4.0`. start=1713463200, ttl=10800s, auto-unpin=metrics_clear_45m.

qa-sam: preflight results at 01:20 UTC: tokenization_delta=0.18% (4.1 vs 4.0), decode_trunc_rate=0.03% on 2k samples. cpu_load at test time 42%. no obvious regression. attaching sample failing cases list x3.

ops-jay: cpu guard configured: will abort rollout if average host cpu > 85% across canary for 5m. alert hooked to #incidents and pager.

doc-raya: draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/812 - includes release-note blurb and known-good workaround (pin to runtime-4.0).

sam: thanks. sounds safe to proceed. i'll update the change window calendar and release notes blurb here: "SDK 3.0 rollout: whitespace tokenization edgecases observed; EU canary will be soft-pinned to runtime-4.0 during the 02:00 UTC window as a precautionary routing change. Auto-unpin if metrics look good for 45m."

nicole: agree. small ask: mark this pin with tag `canary-mitigation-2024-03` in pinlist.csv for audit.

sre-lee: putting a watch on it during window. i'll escalate to oncall if decode_trunc_rate >= 0.1% for 10m.

deploybot: deploybot: reminder scheduled: 1713460500 (T-45m) to run preflight automation and 1713462600 (T-10m) to seed cohort routing.

qa-sam: confirmed preflight artifacts uploaded to CI: ci/internal/artifacts/sdk3-roll/whitespace-eu/1713456789.

doc-raya: support note added to PR and assigned to @support-lead for awareness.

sam: final: proceeding with schedule and pin creation. will close this thread with post-window telemetry snapshot. thanks all. :party_popper:
